ambient_events: The fountains drop for a second, then come back up.
A groundskeeper picks ticket stubs out of a hedge one at a time.
Somebody eats a hot dog on a bench and watches the Coliseum wall.
description: The North Gardens, a parterre of clipped box fanned out toward the Coliseum and planted red, white and gold. There's a sign asking you not to sit on the hedges.
name: North Gardens
